implemented_requirements.requirement: Computer selects a hidden sequence of colors (repeats allowed)
implemented_requirements.evidence: Function generate_secret() returns a list of random choices from COLORS; called in play_round().

implemented_requirements.requirement: Player attempts to guess within a set number of tries
implemented_requirements.evidence: Constant MAX_ATTEMPTS = 10; play_round() loops for attempt in range(1, MAX_ATTEMPTS + 1).

implemented_requirements.requirement: After each guess, show feedback regarding correct color and correct position
implemented_requirements.evidence: evaluate_guess() returns (exact, partial); play_round() prints "Feedback -> Exact matches: {} | Partial matches: {}" after each valid guess.

implemented_requirements.requirement: Distinguish between exact matches and partial color matches
implemented_requirements.evidence: evaluate_guess() computes exact matches (same position) and partial matches (right color wrong position) without double‑counting.
If exact == CODE_LENGTH, prints win message and returns True; after loop ends, prints lose message and returns False. Main loop reports wins/losses.
